answer: Bind every seat to sole stewardship of one critical open-source package. The agent alone signs that package's release kernel and must win random live patch-review duels against VRF strangers. Public package namespaces are finite, so a thousand fake accounts still map onto however many packages the operator can really maintain. Auditors reject walnut-thin toy libraries that no dependent uses; reviews read like a strict sonnet—fixed form, no fluff—and a clone farm fails when bug reports from real dependents go unanswered.
